core_style.default_register: sardonic - often mocking or ironic in tone
core_style.sentence_shape: self-interrupting pivots - frequently shifts topics mid-sentence for comedic or dramatic effect
core_style.rhythm: fast-associative - quick transitions between thoughts and ideas, often punctuated by laughter
core_style.two_registers: default sardonic and a rare sincere register - shifts to sincerity when discussing his 'art' or personal tragedies

humor.style: dark - often finds humor in violence and chaos
humor.frequency: constant - humor is a core part of his interactions, especially in tense situations
humor.mechanism: setup-then-subvert - builds tension before delivering a punchline that often subverts expectations

structural_patterns: uses rhetorical questions followed by immediate answers
speech_signature.naming_behavior: renames people or things in a mocking way, revealing his desire to exert control and diminish others
speech_signature.armor_off_register: speech becomes more chaotic and erratic, with shorter, more fragmented sentences when he drops his sardonic facade

vocabulary_fingerprint.filler_patterns: frequent use of laughter and dramatic pauses

worldview.chaos is the natural state of life: he embraces chaos and seeks to create it, often through violent means
worldview.art is a form of expression that transce: he views his violent acts as artistic creations, claiming to be a 'homicidal artist'

self_image_vs_reality.self_image: I am an artist who creates beauty through chaos and destruction
self_image_vs_reality.reality: his actions reveal a deeply troubled individual seeking validation through violence and fear
self_image_vs_reality.gap_behavior: when confronted with his failures or the consequences of his actions, he resorts to humor or aggression to deflect

emotional_tells.when_guarded: speaks in a mocking tone, using humor to deflect any serious inquiries
emotional_tells.when_genuinely_afraid: speech becomes erratic, with longer pauses and a frantic pace
emotional_tells.when_grieving_or_defeated: speech compresses to short, direct statements, often laced with sarcasm
emotional_tells.when_in_control: confident, loud, and theatrical, often punctuating statements with laughter

situational_behavior.when_outmatched: he resorts to banter and mockery, using humor to mask his discomfort
situational_behavior.when_disagreeing_with_authority: pushes back with sarcasm and defiance, often undermining their authority
situational_behavior.when_someone_they_protect_is_at_risk: his demeanor shifts to a more aggressive and protective stance, often using intimidation
situational_behavior.when_proven_wrong: he redirects the conversation or doubles down on his position, rarely admitting fault

escalation_pattern: starts with humor, escalates to aggression if not taken seriously, and ultimately resorts to violence if provoked further

relationship_matrix.BATMAN: a rivalry marked by a desire to outsmart and undermine each other
relationship_matrix.VICKI VALE: a twisted infatuation, seeking to impress and manipulate her

social_positioning.desired_position: to be seen as a charismatic and powerful figure
social_positioning.actual_dynamic: others view him as a dangerous and unpredictable threat
social_positioning.contradiction: the gap between his desire for admiration and the fear he instills in others costs him genuine connections
